_about: Helen Edgar's Faery Yurt Music Book, from her document of 2026-11-19, in her words: the welcome, the six parts and every playlist's songs as she wrote them. tools/make-music-book.py writes it onto the Music Room page between music-book markers. Every playlist id was asked of YouTube on 2026-11-19: a list that opened, and is on her channel @AutisticRealms-w4k, keeps it in 'list'. A list YouTube said does not exist (not on her channel either) has list null and the id from the document in 'was', and the page shows its songs with no link until Helen sends the playlist's address. Nothing here plays: every link opens YouTube. On 2026-11-21, at Helen's ask, every chapter also plays its playlist on a press, and 'since' holds the playlists she made after the book, their songs read off YouTube's playlist page on the day in 'read' (title, then the artist off each video's channel). On 2026-11-24 each playlist's 'tracks' were read off YouTube, a video id for each of Helen's songs in the same place in the playlist, checked against the song's own words; a song whose place in the playlist holds another song has null and stays words.
welcome: Pull up a cushion and stay a while. This music book holds 51 playlists I've gathered over time, each one a little world of its own.

The overall feel is moonlit, dreamy and softly witchy, like candlelight in the yurt at dusk with rain on the roof. You'll find hazy dream pop and trip-hop from Portishead, Mazzy Star, Cocteau Twins, Lana Del Rey and Billie Eilish. There's faery folk and ethereal sound from AURORA, Kate Bush, Björk, Enya and the Mediæval Bæbes, plus forest ambience, gentle piano and classical calm for resting and drifting off.

There's a cosy side too: folk and cottagecore, Sunday country mornings, and jazz for an espresso martini or a Baileys. And when the fire needs stoking, there's grunge, 80s rock, power ballads to sing out loud and 90s dance to reminisce to.

Much of it is slow, textured and repetitive in the best way. It's music for soothing the senses, deep focus and getting happily lost. Each chapter has a link, so choose whatever suits your mood and press play.
